review_notes: All1624raw bytes and3198organized bytes read directly and separately as this primary review, including every Connection field, both named-property proofs, whole HorizontalSection and its actual predicate proof.

Nabla is a dependent family of types over sections, while horizontal is an independent dependent predicate. The source does not state a relation between them or any linear/covariant-derivative/zero-curvature formula.

The flat and integrable fields are separate Prop values with proof fields. Their two exact projection theorems are genuine conditional proofs, not independently encoded geometric flatness/integrability equations.

HorizontalSection and horizontal_section_is_horizontal form a genuine coherent mathematical predicate-witness seam: the supplied value is proven to satisfy the actual supplied nabla.horizontal predicate. It is not discarded or described as an unrelated named proposition.

That seam depends on the exact local Connection declaration defined earlier in the same file. The sole original import is Crystal. Extracting only the witness pair would require a new IntegrableConnection self-provider import, silent activation or weakened replacement type, while materializing only a subset of Connection would drop fields. The whole source is retained archive-only instead.

The exact Crystal1375B, CrystallineSite1277B and ResearchTopos topology1266B raw providers were fully read again and pinned. Their weak field scopes are retained; no new GRWTSK representation from184/185 is substituted.
The organized Analysis.Integration placement is historical metadata, not an integration or differential-geometric theorem. No source bytes, notices, proof terms or original hypotheses are changed.
